integrity: The theorem has an explicit proof using the tensor-square matrix and finite-field rank stratification, together with reproducible finite-field checks. Finite tests do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the two-loop length-three truncated free associative algebra. It concerns linear rank of derivations, not their Jordan forms or orbit structures. Publication priority remains a bounded best-knowledge assessment.
title: Characteristic-two collapse in the complete derivation-rank spectrum of a truncated free algebra
